title: TLS: Support decrypting TLS 1.3 psk_ke with PSK only
description:
Support decryption of TLS 1.3 psk_ke with the supplied global PSK
preference.

Due to the way the early secret is calculated, this should also work
to decrypt early data if the PSK is known. (It's probably not, because
supporting early data outside of renegotiation is bad.)

If decryption is successful, store it in the maps so that the computed
secret can be injected to a pcapng as part of a DSB.

Not supported: decrypting a resumed session via a PSK provisioned via a
NewSessionTicket message and calculated via resumption_master_secret.
(This would only work if the original handshake was psk_ke, which is
fine because the only way that one could decrypt the original handshake
if EC(DHE) was used is by having the SSLKEYLOG, in which case decrypting
via the PSK on resumption isn't necessary.)

Probably doesn't work: DTLS 1.3 with psk_ke, because the handshake
transcript is different from that of DTLS 1.2 (but the same as that
of TLS 1.3.) It probably could be made to work with a sample.

Fix #20443

AI-Assisted: no
